# Agent onboarding
Date: 2026-11-13 | Duration: 32.18000030517578m

## Summary
The team approved an open-source, account-free SDK wedge for agents, supporting hard-coded on/off, targeting, and percentage flags locally, with a future upgrade path to GrowthBook that adds metrics and instant kill switches while retaining SDK checks. Importing configurations still requires a human to create an account and enter an email, although a frictionless claim flow using a temporary uploaded payload and sign-in or sign-up link is being explored. The JavaScript SDK release gates promotion, with availability planned for next week, alongside a polished claim UI. Launch messaging will lead with a free Feature Flags SDK rather than account creation. Agent-focused tutorials will prioritize TypeScript and cover frameworks and languages, supported by docs, Dev.to, Medium, and a submitted guide covering browser, React, and Next.js. Video content and influencer outreach were proposed after baseline content. The product tour is live, while GrowthBook domain migration and an A/B test comparing signup with free access remain pending.

## Keywords
Feature flags SDK, Coding agents, GrowthBook onboarding, TypeScript integrations, Agent-focused documentation, Interactive product demo
